g.text: Original educational diagrams • static reference • conceptual examples
Conceptual scale only; VPN is a logical overlay.
Geographically separated LANs use carrier connectivity.
Reachability is exchanged between routing domains.
Clients join an access point via radio links.
An authenticated tunnel connects approved endpoints.
Distinct office prefixes connected by two gateways.
Physical and virtual interfaces carry different routes.
Lab traffic through VPN; ordinary traffic through ISP.
